en.name: Chocolate syrup
en.summary: Bottled chocolate syrup keeps about 2 years from purchase unopened in the cupboard, and about 6 months refrigerated once it is opened. It is a sugar syrup rather than a dairy sauce, which is why the numbers are so generous.
en.pantry: An unopened bottle keeps about 2 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard, or to the printed date if that is sooner. The sugar concentration is what does the preserving: there is not enough available water in a syrup this sweet for bacteria to work with, which is the same principle that keeps honey and jam. Keep it out of sunlight and away from the hob, since heat darkens the syrup and can crystallise the sugar at the neck of the bottle.
en.fridge: After opening, refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 6 months. The syrup will thicken considerably in the cold, so squeeze bottles need a moment under warm running water or a good shake before they behave. Wipe the nozzle and the neck before closing it — dried syrup around the cap is where mould appears first, and it is the part of the bottle people never clean. Keep the bottle upright so the residue does not sit in the cap.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for chocolate syrup, and freezing it makes little sense. A syrup this sugary does not freeze solid, so you gain no real storage advantage, and the cold encourages the sugar to crystallise into a gritty sludge that does not fully redissolve. The cupboard and fridge figures between them cover a bottle far longer than most households take to finish one.
spoilage: Mould at the nozzle, under the cap or at the surface of the syrup.
A fermented, alcoholic or yeasty smell rather than a cocoa one.
The bottle swollen or the cap domed, which means something is producing gas inside it.
Grainy crystallisation with separated liquid that will not stir back together.
tips: Wipe the nozzle and the neck before you close the bottle.
Store it upright so syrup does not sit in the cap.
Warm a thickened bottle under running water rather than in the microwave.
Write the opening date on the label; six months is easy to lose track of.

faq.q: How long does chocolate syrup keep?
faq.a: About 2 years from purchase unopened in the cupboard, and about 6 months refrigerated after opening.

faq.q: Does chocolate syrup need refrigerating after opening?
faq.a: Yes, that is where the opened figure applies. It thickens in the cold, so warm the bottle briefly before use.
There is no timeline for it and no point — a syrup this sugary will not freeze solid, and cold makes the sugar crystallise.

zh.name: 巧克力糖漿
zh.summary: 瓶裝巧克力糖漿未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算約 2 年；開封後冷藏約 6 個月。它是糖漿而不是乳製醬汁，這就是數字這麼寬裕的原因。
zh.pantry: 未開封的瓶子放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算約 2 年，若標示日期更早則以標示為準。做保存工作的是糖濃度：這麼甜的糖漿裡沒有足夠的自由水給細菌利用，和蜂蜜、果醬是同一個原理。請避免陽光直射並遠離爐台，高溫會讓糖漿顏色變深，也可能讓瓶口的糖結晶。
zh.fridge: 開封後放 4 °C 以下，約 6 個月內用完。低溫下糖漿會明顯變稠，所以擠壓瓶通常要沖一下溫水或用力搖幾下才聽話。蓋上蓋子前先把噴嘴和瓶頸擦乾淨——瓶蓋周圍乾掉的糖漿是最先長霉的地方，偏偏那是大家永遠不會清的部位。瓶子請直立存放，殘留才不會積在蓋子裡。
zh.freezer: 這裡沒有給巧克力糖漿的冷凍期限，而且冷凍也沒什麼道理。這麼甜的糖漿根本不會凍成硬塊，保存上得不到實質好處；低溫反而容易讓糖結晶成粗糙的糊狀，而且化不太回去。櫥櫃和冷藏這兩個數字加起來，已經遠比多數家庭用完一瓶的時間長了。
spoilage: 噴嘴、蓋子內側或糖漿表面長霉。
聞起來有發酵味、酒精味或酵母味，而不是可可香。
瓶身鼓起或瓶蓋隆起，代表裡面有東西在產氣。
出現粗糙的結晶，並分離出攪不回去的液體。
tips: 蓋回去之前先把噴嘴和瓶頸擦乾淨。
直立存放，糖漿才不會積在蓋子裡。
變稠就沖溫水，不要微波。
在標籤上寫開封日期；六個月很容易忘記。

faq.q: 巧克力糖漿可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算約 2 年；開封後冷藏約 6 個月。

faq.q: 巧克力糖漿開封後要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 要，開封後那個數字就是以冷藏為前提。它在低溫下會變稠，用前稍微回溫即可。

faq.q: 巧克力糖漿可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有對應期限，也沒有意義——這麼甜的糖漿凍不硬，低溫還會讓糖結晶。
